questions.question: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, which of the following is the customer responsible for managing?
options: Physical security of data center facilities
Customer data encryption and IAM user access permissions
Decommissioning of failed physical storage drives
questions.explanation: Customers are responsible for security IN the cloud, including data encryption, identity access management, and OS configurations.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides low-latency content delivery worldwide through a global network of edge locations?
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudFront is a fast Content Delivery Network (CDN) service that securely delivers data, videos, and APIs via edge locations.

questions.question: Which AWS storage service provides object storage with virtually unlimited scalability and 99.999999999% (11 9s) durability?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 is an industry-leading object storage service offering 11 9s of data durability.

questions.question: A builder needs to run application code in response to events without provisioning or managing servers. Which service should they choose?
questions.explanation: AWS Lambda lets you run code without provisioning or managing servers, paying only for compute time consumed.

questions.question: Which AWS Well-Architected Framework pillar focuses on running workloads effectively, gaining insight into operations, and continuously improving processes?
questions.explanation: The Operational Excellence pillar focuses on running and monitoring systems to deliver business value, and continually improving processes.
